For eta^k=mu^k-delta z^k and x*=-(Q+delta I)^-1 q, x^{k+1}-x*=-(Q+delta I)^-1 eta^k, z^{k+1}-x*=(Q-delta I)(Q+delta I)^-1 eta^k/(2delta), and mu^{k+1}=delta z^{k+1}. Thus eta^1=0 for arbitrary initialization and exactly x²=z²=x*, mu²=delta x*, with one-update termination iff eta^0=0 (invertibility of Q+delta I). Independently exact rational scalar witness Q=2 delta=1 q=-3 z0=0 mu0=1 produces first (2/3,7/6,7/6), second (1,1,1). Proof is general matrix algebra, not finite empirical extrapolation.
